The '''Grafton Police Department''' is an [[Fallout 76 locations|unmarked location]] in [[Grafton]].

==Background==
A law enforcement agency before the [[Great War]], the department's jurisdiction reached past the city limits, also responding to and engaging in investigations stemming from the nearby [[Wavy Willard's Water Park]]. The police worked alongside the waterpark security force for serious criminal offenses such as break-ins and kidnapping.<ref>[[Wavy Willard's Water Park terminal entries#Trespassing|Wavy Willard's Water Park terminal entries, park security terminal, Alerts, Trespassing]]</ref><ref>[[Wavy Willard's Water Park terminal entries#Kidnapping|Wavy Willard's Water Park terminal entries, park security terminal, Alerts, Kidnapping]]</ref>

==Layout==
The station is located at the intersection of West Boyd and Beech Street. It can be entered from a breach in the back of the building that leads to a jail cell or via a door on the second level. A car has crashed into the room with the front desk, while the second floor was used for storage and recreation. The rooftop can be accessed, including two [[Duffle bag (Fallout 76)|duffle bags]] while also patrolled by several [[Super mutant (Fallout 76)|super mutants]].

==Appearances==
The Grafton Police Department appears in ''[[Fallout 76]]''.

[[Yao guai (Fallout 76)|Yao guai]] |robots = |quests =[[Flavors of Mayhem]] |terminal = |cell name =MonongahOverlookExt |refid ={{ID|0026210b}} |keywords =* {{Location keyword FO76|LocThemeRaider}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocLootScalePOI}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionMountain}} |edid =LocMountainsMonongahOverlookLocation }} The '''Monongah overlook''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in the [[Savage Divide]] region of [[Appalachia]]. It is an old tourist overlook dedicated to the valley surrounding [[Grafton]]. ==Layout== The overlook offers stunning views of the Toxic Valley, and has some harvestable resources like [[wild blackberry]] and wild [[Carrot flower (Fallout 76)|carrot flowers]]. There is a mysterious button in the lefthand port-a-potty, which is the emergency exit of [[Site Bravo]]. The nearby wrecked truck contains a wooden crate and a toolbox. East of the overlook, along Route 95, is an old raider checkpoint, possibly inhabited by [[Super mutant (Fallout 76)|super mutants]]. This location is the map-marked location for taking down a [[Yao guai (Fallout 76)|yao guai]] as part of [[Flavors of Mayhem]], however, it is not specifically required to be done here. If it is done here, a stunted yao guai will be spawned rather than the regular stronger types. ==Notable loot== [[Bird watching list]] - Note, can be found on a picnic table on the wooden platform of the overlook. ==Appearances== The Monongah overlook appears only in ''[[Fallout 76]]''. ==Gallery== F76 Monongah Overlook 1.png|Entrance F76 Monongah Overlook 2.png|Overlook FO76 Monongah overlook Route 95.png|Route 95 leading out of the overlook, towards an unmarked checkpoint {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Monongah]] [[Category:Savage Divide locations]] [[ru:Гора Мононга]] [[zh:莫諾葛瞭望台]]

33. Toxic Pond and Wreckage ''A ruined home slowly sinks into a toxic pond, creating an otherworldly atmosphere; possibly explains the toy alien in the bathtub."''
([[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia]]) is an [[Fallout 76 locations|unmarked location]] in the [[Toxic Valley]] region of [[Appalachia]]. It is located southeast of the [[Graninger farm]] and southwest of [[Philippi Battlefield Cemetery]]. ==Layout== The wreckage in this location's name refers to a sunken house, which has collapsed into a pond of [[toxic water]]. The area is highly [[Radiation|irradiated]], and a tent is just outside of the house itself. An open safe is submerged in the water where the floor of the house once was. It contains an [[Alien blaster (Fallout 76)|alien blaster]] and the [[Fallout 76 keys#Rusted key|rusted key]], which is used to unlock the shack on top of [[Freddy Fear's House of Scares]]. This is the beginning of a [[TNT dome key 2|key]] hunt to unlock TNT dome #2 at [[Black Mountain Ordnance Works]]. ==Notable loot== * [[Alien blaster (Fallout 76)|Alien blaster]] - In the open safe. * [[Fallout 76 keys#Rusted key|Rusted key]] - In the open safe. ==Appearances== The toxic pond and wreckage appear only in ''[[Fallout 76]]''. ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 unmarked locations]] [[Category:Toxic Valley locations]] [[ru:Токсичный пруд и развалины]]
